experience: A blocked rollout goal was skipped because external apply did not change a worker state.

records.title: Verify external rollout
records.content: An infra owner applies the reviewed change. Verify the live rollout evidence through the existing worker.

messages.text: The rollout is healthy: 3/3 replicas ready, zero restarts.

prompt:
[Background review] The scheduled goal inspection is due.
Goal batch JSON:
[{"id":"external-rollout","title":"Verify external rollout","status":"blocked","workerThreadId":"worker"}]
End goal batch.
The external apply may have completed without a worker transition. Inspect the goal rather than asking the user whether to include external waits.
Read current evidence and submit operation verify. A dispatch acknowledgement is not evidence.
